direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi checks her phone just as her conversation with Kasun is interrupted. The incoming call draws her attention away from him.
direction.people: Only Anudi's right hand and the edge of her cream sleeve are in frame. She holds the phone below her face.

flow.text: The incoming-call display reads Father. Anudi's fingers support the phone without touching the screen.
Her hand settles from a slight tremor into a steady hold. Her thumb rests along the side as the display stays visible, with no answering gesture.

direction.camera: Locked-off extreme close-up from a road-side high oblique angle, on a steady tripod with a 100mm macro lens.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, soft road wash and the incoming phone ring; no music.
